name: minecraft-redstone
description: Build and debug vanilla redstone with compact game data, backed-up construction plans and tick traces.

interface.shortDescription: Build and inspect Minecraft with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Minecraft Java 26.3 bridge with compact structured observation, inventory views, backed-up construction, named buses, tick recordings and bounded local test jobs through MCP or CLI. Live validation includes all 256 four-bit operand pairs with carry-in zero, fault detection and one-cell undo. Separate spectator control requires another rendered client. Local Node.js 22+ and Java 25 required.
defaultPrompt: Check the Minecraft connection and inspect my redstone test area.
Help me build and understand my next redstone circuit.
